questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation. 16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

We have to put the mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) × ÷ + -

Given: 16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22

⇒ 16 × 3 ÷ 2 + 11 - 9 = 22

⇒ 16 × 1.5 + 11 - 9 = 22

⇒ 24 + 11 - 9 = 22

⇒ 35 - 9 = 22

⇒ 26 ≠ 22 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) × ÷ − +

Given: 16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22

⇒ 16 × 3 ÷ 2 - 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 16 × 1.5 - 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 24 - 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 33 - 11 = 22

⇒ 22 = 22

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 3) ÷ × + +

Given: 16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22

⇒ 16 ÷ 3 × 2 + 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 5.33 × 2 + 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 10.6 + 11 + 9 = 22

⇒ 30.6 ≠ 22

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷ + × ÷

Given: 16 * 3 * 2 * 11 * 9 = 22

⇒ 16 ÷ 3 + 2 × 11 ÷ 9 = 22 

⇒ 5.33 + 2 × 1.22 = 22

⇒ 5.33 + 2.44 = 22

⇒ 7.77 ≠ 22

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Logic: \( {\sqrt{First Number} } \) : (First number)2 + First number = Second number.

Let's check them one by one.

1) 16 : 20

⇒ \({ \sqrt{16} }\) = 4 : (4)2 + 4 

⇒ 16 + 4 = 20

And,

2) 49 : 56

⇒ \({ \sqrt{49} }\) = 7 : (7)2 + 7

⇒ 49 + 7 = 56

Similarly,

3) 256 : ?

⇒ \({ \sqrt{256} }\) = 16 : (16)2 + 16

⇒ 256 + 16 = 272

Hence, the correct answer is "272".

questions.solution: When a river approaches the sea, it forms a delta, which is a triangular deposition of sediments brought by the river. questions.questionHtml: If α, β are the roots of 6x2 + 13x + 7 = 0, then the equation whose roots are α2, β2 is:
questions.solution:
If α and β be the roots,then the quadretic equation be  x2 - (α + β) x + αβ = 0

In the given equation 6x2 + 13x + 7 = 0, then (α + β) = - (13/6) and αβ = 7/6, so α2β2 = 49/36

(α + β)2 = α2 + β2 + 2αβ ⇒ 169/36 = α2 + β2 + 7/3 ⇒ α2 + β2  = 85/36

Now, x2 - (α2 + β2)x + α2β2 = 0 ⇒ x2 - 85/36x + 49/36 = 0 ⇒ 36x2 - 85x + 49 = 0

X is directly proportional to the square of Y. So, X = Y2k  [ k be any constant ]

questions.questionHtml: The expenditure on the cost of living of a man and his family is 60% of his salary. He gets two increment of 30% and 60% in his salary. If his saving increases by 250% of his initial saving, then the new cost of living expenditure is what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the increased salary?
questions.solution:
Let the salary of the man be 100a

So, expenditure = 100a × 60% ⇒ 60a

Savings = 100a - 60a ⇒ 40a

Now, His new salary = 100a × 130% × 160% ⇒ 208a

His new savings = 40a + 40a × 250% ⇒ 140a

New Expenditure = 208a - 140a ⇒ 68a

Required % = (68a/208a) × 100 ⇒ 32.69 ≈ 32.70%

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
  • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
    • Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • Example:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'They'.​​
  • The object of the given sentence is 'A kite'. 
  • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
  • And 'flew' will be changed into 'was flown'. 
  • Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added.
     

Correct Sentence: A kite was flown by them in the evening.
